biggest_catch: Your friend must complete everything — open checking + savings, enroll in online banking, and complete 8 qualifying transactions within 60 days — and bonuses pay roughly 75 days after account opening.
catches: Friend must qualify for Express CU membership (live or work in Washington State; exceptions for immediate family)
Referring member must complete the referral form on the website AND the friend must select 'Referral Campaign' as the referral source during application
Friend must open a checking account, savings account, and enroll in online banking
Friend must complete 8 or more qualifying transactions within 60 days of account opening
Accounts must remain open and in good standing for at least 60 days
Friend must not be an existing member or have been a member in the past 6 months
Referring member must be 18+, in good standing, and primary on the account
Bonuses may be reported to the IRS (1099-MISC for the referring member)

c4.evidence: Friend must open checking + savings, enroll in online banking, and complete 8 qualifying transactions (debit purchases, direct deposits, ACH, checks, ATM/cash/in-branch activity) within 60 days of account opening

eligibility: Referrer must be an Express Credit Union member, 18+, in good standing, and primary on the account. Friend must be eligible for Express CU membership (live or work in Washington State; immediate family exceptions) and must not be an existing member or have been one in the past 6 months.
notes: Express Credit Union (expresscu.org), Washington State. Distinct from Expree Credit Union (R4762, expree.org); R5747 was wrongly rejected as a duplicate of R4762 and has now been converted to a verified route. Official terms page fetched live 2026-09-23. No stated referral cap or expiration; standing offer subject to termination at any time.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($100 cash to the referrer per qualifying referral); time: referral form share 5-15 min active
payout_quote: Refer a friend or family member, and you'll both earn $100 when they open an account and complete the program requirements. After the first 60 days, Express Credit Union will review the account activity to verify eligibility. Once verified, $100 will be deposited into both the referring member's savings account and the new member's savings account within approximately 75 days of account opening.
payout_value_note: $100 cash deposited to the referrer's savings account per qualifying referral; no referral cap stated.

steps: Complete the referral form on www.expresscu.org/refer/ with your name and your friend's name and email address
Express CU emails your friend with information about how to open an account
Your friend applies for membership (online, in person, or by phone) and selects 'Referral Campaign' as the referral source
Your friend opens a checking account, a savings account, and enrolls in online banking
Your friend completes 8 or more qualifying transactions within 60 days of account opening (debit card purchases, direct deposits, ACH transfers, checks, ATM/cash/in-branch deposits or withdrawals)
After the 60-day review, your $100 bonus is deposited into your savings account within approximately 75 days of account opening
timing: Bonus deposited to the referring member's savings account within approximately 75 days of account opening, after the 60-day activity review.
